ai_palette.description: AI-powered interactive learning assistant with pre-created prompts for topics, lessons, and illustrations

modes.name: Quick Question
modes.description: Ask any question about current topic
modes.placeholder: Ask me anything about this topic...

modes.name: Deep Dive
modes.placeholder: Explain this in detail with examples...

modes.name: Practice Problem
modes.placeholder: Generate practice problems on this topic

modes.name: Visual Explanation
modes.placeholder: Show me a diagram or illustration of this concept

modes.name: Real World Example
modes.placeholder: How is this used in real life?

Basic_Arithmetic.prompt: Explain addition and subtraction with real objects (coins, fruits). Show step-by-step solution for: 25 + 18 = ?
Basic_Arithmetic.illustration_suggestion: Interactive counter animation showing 25 coins + 18 coins = 43 coins

Basic_Arithmetic.prompt: Create a practice problem: 'A store has 30 apples. 12 are sold. How many remain?'
Basic_Arithmetic.illustration_suggestion: Animated apple tree visualization showing before/after

Basic_Arithmetic.prompt: Show number line method for solving: 45 - 17 = ?
Basic_Arithmetic.illustration_suggestion: Interactive number line with animation from 45 down to 17

Fractions.prompt: Explain fractions using pizza slices. What is 1/2 + 1/4?
Fractions.illustration_suggestion: Animated pizza divided into fractions with interactive drag-and-combine

Fractions.prompt: How are fractions used in cooking? Give recipe examples with 1/2 cup, 1/4 cup measurements

Linear_Equations.prompt: Explain solving linear equations using balance method. Solve: 2x + 3 = 9
Linear_Equations.illustration_suggestion: Interactive balance scale showing both sides of equation, weights moving as operations are performed
Animated whiteboard showing algebraic steps with color-coded variables and numbers

Geometry.prompt: Explain how to calculate area and perimeter of rectangles. Use interactive diagram.
Geometry.illustration_suggestion: Interactive rectangle tool: drag corners to change dimensions, see formulas update in real-time

Geometry.prompt: How is geometry used in architecture and design? Show real buildings/designs.
Geometry.illustration_suggestion: Image gallery of geometric buildings with overlaid geometric shapes

Quadratic_Equations.prompt: Explain quadratic equations by graphing. Show parabola for y = x² - 5x + 6
Quadratic_Equations.illustration_suggestion: Interactive graph plotting tool showing parabola, roots marked, and factorization

Quadratic_Equations.prompt: Compare three methods: Factoring, Completing the Square, Quadratic Formula for x² - 5x + 6 = 0
Quadratic_Equations.illustration_suggestion: Three-panel interactive showing all methods side-by-side with animations

Parts_of_Speech.prompt: Identify parts of speech in sentences. Hover over words to see their role.
Parts_of_Speech.illustration_suggestion: Interactive text with color-coded parts of speech (nouns=blue, verbs=red, etc.)

Parts_of_Speech.prompt: Match words to their parts of speech in an interactive drag-and-drop
Parts_of_Speech.illustration_suggestion: Interactive matching game with animated feedback

Spelling.prompt: Show correct spelling with letter-by-letter breakdown and pronunciation
Spelling.illustration_suggestion: Animated text showing each letter appearing with phonetic guide

Literary_Devices.prompt: Explain similes with real examples. Create a chart: Simile Examples → Visual Representation
Literary_Devices.illustration_suggestion: Interactive chart showing similes with drawings (e.g., 'White as snow' → snowflake image)

Literary_Devices.prompt: Read passages and identify literary devices used. Label each one.
Literary_Devices.illustration_suggestion: Interactive text highlighting with popup explanations of each device

Literary_Devices.prompt: Create your own simile, metaphor, and personification for common objects
Literary_Devices.illustration_suggestion: Interactive writing prompt with illustration suggestions

Essay_Writing.prompt: Break down essay structure: Hook, Thesis, Body, Conclusion with examples
Essay_Writing.illustration_suggestion: Interactive diagram showing essay structure with real examples expandable at each section

Essay_Writing.prompt: Create an interactive essay outline builder for topic: 'Impact of Technology on Education'
Essay_Writing.illustration_suggestion: Mind map visualization that auto-expands with AI suggestions

Motion_and_Speed.prompt: Simulate motion: Set initial velocity and acceleration, watch object move
Motion_and_Speed.illustration_suggestion: Interactive physics simulator with animated object, vectors showing velocity and acceleration

Motion_and_Speed.prompt: Real examples: Car acceleration, falling object, thrown ball. Show calculations.
Motion_and_Speed.illustration_suggestion: Animated scenarios with speed/acceleration values shown in real-time

Forces.prompt: Demonstrate Newton's 3 laws with interactive animations and examples
Forces.illustration_suggestion: Three interactive demos: inertia, F=ma, action-reaction with draggable objects

Waves.prompt: Create interactive wave simulator: adjust frequency, wavelength, amplitude
Waves.illustration_suggestion: Interactive sine wave generator with real-time visualization of parameter changes

Waves.prompt: Compare sound waves, light waves, and water waves side-by-side
Waves.illustration_suggestion: Three-panel comparison with animated wave representations

Electricity.prompt: Build circuits interactively: place components, see current flow
Electricity.illustration_suggestion: Drag-and-drop circuit simulator with glowing electrons showing current flow

List what they have in common
